skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand key tax concepts, characteristics, and roles.
Understand the components that make up a tax and the criteria for an optimal tax system.
Grasp the principles and content of tax management.
Understand the history, concept, characteristics, role, application conditions, legal framework, calculation methods, and VAT management.
Understand the concept, characteristics, role, relationship with other taxes, legal framework, calculation methods, and special consumption tax management.
Understand the concept, characteristics, role, legal framework, anti-dumping tax, and export/import tax management.
Understand the origin, concept, characteristics, role, relationship with consumption taxes, legal framework, and corporate income tax management.
Understand the basis, purpose, concept, characteristics, role, relationship with indirect taxes and other direct taxes, legal framework, and personal income tax management.
Understand various types of taxes such as business license tax, land use tax, environmental tax, agricultural land use tax, resource tax, and construction tax.
Analyze achievements and limitations in tax management and propose solutions.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate tax management issues.
Apply methods to calculate the amount of tax payable for different types of taxes.
